# `code.blob.get`

Show a file at a revision

Text inlines to the readout cap; larger files truncate. Binary reports size only. Line highlight is ?lines=.

- Method and path: `GET /{owner}/{repo}/blob/{rev}/{path...}`
- Scope: `public:read`
- Kind: `read`
- CLI: `rukie code blob get`
- MCP: `code_blob_get`
- ETag: served; send it back as If-Match to write safely

## Inputs

| Name | In | Required | Type |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `lines` | query | no | `string` |
| `owner` | path | yes | `string` |
| `path` | path | yes | `string` |
| `repo` | path | yes | `string` |
| `rev` | path | yes | `string` |

## Errors

`conflict`, `forbidden`, `invalid`, `not-found`, plus the framework problems.
